_comment: Guided tour for the legacy export window. Steps point at the controls the window registers (item_rects) and wait for the user to press them; the tour never presses a button itself.

steps.title: What this does
steps.text: The workflow tools read and write .pto containers only. This window writes the layouts older tools still read: the Seidel/Margarita burst folder (bi4_bur/*.bur plus one companion folder per analysis) and the five ALEX-Suite CSV files. The container stays the record; the export is a view of it.

steps.title: Start with a container whose contents are known
steps.text: The example is the Burst Selection demo stream (12 planted bursts) with two runs: a burst search, burstwise, and a burst variance analysis, bva. Your own container goes in through Open… or by dropping it on the window.

steps.title: The plan: what each run becomes
steps.text: One row per analysis in the container: its run, the table inside it, the operation that wrote it, and the companion ending it becomes. The burst search becomes bi4_bur/bs_demo.bur, the BVA the companion bv4/bs_demo.bv4. A dash means no registered companion: that analysis is skipped, never guessed.

steps.title: Where to write
steps.text: The burst folder is written below this folder, one subfolder per burst-search run. It defaults to the container's folder.

steps.title: Write the burst folder
steps.text: Every companion is merged by position, one row per burst, so a skipped burst is a zero row, not a missing one. The files written are listed under the status line.

steps.title: ALEX-Suite CSVs: pick the burst search
steps.text: The CSVs are E/S histograms over the bursts of one burst-search run. Only runs that hold a burst table are offered.

steps.title: Which tables
steps.text: meta carries sample and buffer, hist_E, hist_S and hist_2D the histograms, original_bursts the burst table itself. The thresholds are the defaults and the corrections neutral; the files carry no fit curves.

steps.title: Write the CSVs
steps.text: The files are written beside the container's name with the suffix _alex in the output folder.

steps.title: Further reading
steps.text: ? opens the help: what the export keeps, what it leaves out, and why the .pto stays the record.
